text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: いつもと雰囲気が違うから

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I'm up against Creek? Or
because
people have such high
expectations for me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When we watched the Arima Kinen last
year, I
could sense so much passion and
excitement from
the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Today, that's all gonna be for me—I'll
make sure
of it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna drive the crowd wild!
